The callee body's subscript p[i][j] scales by the RUNTIME pointee row size (n*sizeof(int)), frozen ONCE at the callee prologue from the incoming `n` param (the C3/C4a-local vlaStrideSlot + scaleIndexToBytes substrate, now populated for a ptr-to-VLA PARAM).
